content.short: A trade guild to represent and support Stake Pool Operators in order to maintain a healthy, secure, and decentralized Cardano network infrastructure.
content.description:
SPOCRA’s vision makes us a trusted ally of stake pool operators that provides the tools they need to succeed. We are a trade association of stake pool operators existing to serve the backbone of the Cardano blockchain by being both re-active and pro-active to all matters affecting Cardano Stake Pool Operators.

We gather community consensus via our collaboration network, polls and on-chain voting to help ensure the health of the Cardano Public Blockchain and the success of its stake pool operators. SPOCRA provides a unified channel of Education, Support and Communication between our members and those parties which contract with the Cardano community.
